name: Rallying Cry
description: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon.

stats: Exerted Attacks deal 5% more Damage per affected Ally, to a maximum of 25%

Buff grants Added Attack Damage equal to 4% of the Damage of your Main
Hand Weapon per 5 Power, counting a maximum of 30 Power
Buff has 100% more Effect on your Minions
Counts total Power of Enemies and Allies in Range
